structure.unit: Municipal and County Airports and Other Air Navigation Facilities
Acquisition, Establishment and Operation Generally; Outside Easements

law.catch_line: Use of airport property for industrial development purposes
law.text: Notwithstanding § 5.1-39, any county, city, town, or airport commission may use, lease or convey for any industrial development purposes any airport property described in § 5.1-39 with the written approval of the Director of Aviation on such terms and conditions as the Director may require. When any easement, rights, or privileges have been pledged as a sponsor's share to secure funds from the Federal Aviation Administration, written approval of the Federal Aviation Administration shall also be required.
